diff --git a/.github/workflows/container.yml b/.github/workflows/container.yml
index e4b4ea33c2..711fd78638 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/container.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/container.yml
@@ -13,6 +13,8 @@ on:
       - misc/gon/**
       - lib/**
   workflow_dispatch:
+  release:
+    types: [published]
 
 permissions:
   contents: read
@@ -23,6 +25,7 @@ concurrency:
 
 jobs:
   build:
+    if: github.event_name != 'release'
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
@@ -93,3 +96,34 @@ jobs:
             "$IMAGE:sha-$REVISION-amd64" \
             "$IMAGE:sha-$REVISION-arm64"
           docker buildx imagetools inspect "$IMAGE:sha-$REVISION"
+
+  release:
+    if: github.event_name == 'release' && !github.event.release.prerelease
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      packages: write
+    env:
+      IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
+      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
+      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
+      - uses: docker/login-action@v4
+        with:
+          registry: ghcr.io
+          username: ${{ github.actor }}
+          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+      - name: Publish stable tags for the release's tested image
+        run: |
+          [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v2\.27\.[0-9]+$ ]]
+          REVISION="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+          docker buildx imagetools create \
+            --tag "$IMAGE:$RELEASE_TAG" \
+            --tag "$IMAGE:2.27" \
+            --tag "$IMAGE:latest" \
+            "$IMAGE:sha-$REVISION"
+          docker buildx imagetools inspect "$IMAGE:$RELEASE_TAG"
